meta.cause_summary: h56: 2 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 7 h (low -11 C)), rising to 5 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 10 h (low -12 C)) by h59 -> h60: 2.0 GW of units failed to start in the cold -> h61: Lubbock below -5 C for 12 h (low -12 C) -> h75: gas wells freezing (basin temp -5 C): production -11%, rising to production -25% by h93 -> h82: wind turbines iced or too cold: 29% of wind fleet stopped, rising to 51% of wind fleet stopped by h104 -> h85: demand surge to 64,290 MW -> h85: rotating outages begin (1,000 MW) -> h112: 2 GW of gas plants without fuel, rising to 5 GW of gas plants without fuel by h176 -> h124: reserves below 2,300 MW (1,828 MW) -> survived with rotating outages (peak 18,735 MW)
